Account.description: What `/api/me` answers: the public player plus what only the owner sees.

mustChangePassword.description:
Set after an admin reset. The API only reports it: the site forces the
change before it shows any other page.

ApiErrorBody.description: The one shape every failure has on the wire.

cause.description: The chain of causes. It is absent if a user can see the response.

cycles.description: One amount per tier, in the order of `tiers`.

Bracket.description:
Every match of a tournament, round by round. `rounds[0]` is round 1 and the
last round holds the final alone.

Checkin.description:
One player at the door. The row goes with the player, so the player is
always there.

CheckinAdd.description:
Body of `POST /api/admin/events/{id}/checkins`: an admin checks a player in
by hand, for a night that is over or a phone that did not scan.

CheckinGate.description:
Answer of `GET /api/checkin/{code}`: what the door shows before a player
confirms. The server decides the window, so no client reads a clock.

CheckinReceipt.description:
Answer of `POST /api/checkin/{code}`. A repeat answers the time of the
first check-in and pays nothing.

cycles.description: What this call paid: the check-in cycles the first time, zero after.

CheckinWindow.description:
Where `now` sits against the window of an event. The door pays only while
it is `Open`.

Checkins.description: Answer of `GET /api/me/checkins`: the events the caller checked in to.

CyclesLog.description:
Answer of `GET /api/players/{handle}/cycles`: one page of the log, and the
total of every kind over the whole log, so a page can show where the
cycles came from without reading every line.

totals.description: Kinds with at least one line, in the order of `PointKind::ALL`.

CyclesRules.description:
Answer of `GET /api/cycles/rules`: every way to earn cycles, the field tiers
and the ladder. Built from the same code the ledger pays from, so a legend
cannot disagree with it.

awards.description: In the order a player earns them: entry, wins, then placements.

Entrant.description:
A registration. `player` is absent after the player deleted their account,
so an old bracket keeps its shape.

seed.description: Set by the bracket. Seed 1 is the first in the generated order.

oneOf.description:
What the player said when they applied. Absent when an admin added them
without a level.

EntrantAdd.description:
Body of `POST /api/admin/tournaments/{id}/entrants`. The level is optional:
an admin backfills players who never applied.

ErrorCode.description:
Each error code the API can answer with. A client selects on these names, so
they are part of the contract.

Two steps make a response from an error: `ServiceError::public` below selects
the code, and `From<ErrorCode> for StatusCode` in `server.rs` selects the
status.

Event.description:
An event as every client sees it. The check-in code is not here: only an
admin reads it, through [`EventDetail`].

endsAt.description: The last game. Past it the check-in is over.

startsAt.description: The doors open, and with them the check-in.

EventDetail.description:
Answer of `GET /api/admin/events/{id}`: the event, the code for the QR at
the door, and everyone who came.

EventFields.description:
Body of `POST /api/admin/events` and of `PUT /api/admin/events/{id}`. A
put replaces every field, so an absent cover clears the cover. A new event
is always a draft.

EventStatus.description: `Draft` is visible to admins only, and its code opens nothing.

FieldTier.description:
The size of the field. A placement pays more in a bigger field. The cuts sit
on bracket sizes, so a tier changes where a round is added, and the top
tier is a cap: forty players are not twice the cup of twenty.

Glyph.description:
What the players table stores: the grid and the color. Generated one time at
signup and then read, never recomputed.

GlyphBits.description: Row-major 5x5 grid as one integer. Bit 0 is the top left cell.

GlyphColor.description:
One of the twelve palette colors. It serializes as the hex string the web
uses, so a stored value and a rendered value never disagree.

HandleChange.description:
Request body of `PUT /api/me/handle` and `PUT /api/admin/players/{id}/handle`.
The glyph stays with the player. Only the name changes.

ImageName.description: A file name under the event images of the site

Match.description:
One match. `round` starts at 1, `slot` at 0. An empty side is a bye in round
1 and an undecided feeder afterwards.

NewTournament.description: Body of `POST /api/admin/tournaments`. A new tournament is always a draft.

Paginated_Event.description: One page of results, and the totals a client needs for a pager.

items.description:
An event as every client sees it. The check-in code is not here: only an
admin reads it, through [`EventDetail`].

endsAt.description: The last game. Past it the check-in is over.

startsAt.description: The doors open, and with them the check-in.

total.description: Every row that matches, ignoring the window.

Paginated_Player.description: One page of results, and the totals a client needs for a pager.

items.description: A player, as the API shows it to anyone. It holds no credential.

standing.description:
Cycles, rank and place. Derived from the ledger on every read, so it is
never stale.

total.description: Every row that matches, ignoring the window.

Paginated_PointEntry.description: One page of results, and the totals a client needs for a pager.

items.description:
One line of the history. `note` is present on an adjustment: the reason an
admin gave, written for everyone. A tournament line names its tournament,
and a check-in names its event.

total.description: Every row that matches, ignoring the window.

Paginated_Tournament.description: One page of results, and the totals a client needs for a pager.

items.description:
A tournament as every client sees it. `entrant_count` and `has_bracket` ride
along so a list needs no second call per row.

date.description: The day of the event. A day has no timezone.

registrationClosesAt.description: Registrations close at this instant. Past it, nobody applies or retires.

total.description: Every row that matches, ignoring the window.

Player.description: A player, as the API shows it to anyone. It holds no credential.

standing.description:
Cycles, rank and place. Derived from the ledger on every read, so it is
never stale.

PointEntry.description:
One line of the history. `note` is present on an adjustment: the reason an
admin gave, written for everyone. A tournament line names its tournament,
and a check-in names its event.

PointKind.description:
The source of an entry. A client selects on these names to label the
history, so they are part of the contract. A placement is its own kind, so
no client has to read a meaning out of an amount.

Rank.description:
The tiers of the ladder, in order. A rank never goes down on its own: only
an adjustment can take cycles away.

RegistrationRequest.description:
Body of `POST /api/tournaments/{id}/registration`. A player applies with the
level they give themself. A second apply with another level changes it.

Registrations.description:
Answer of `GET /api/me/registrations`: the tournaments the caller entered.
One call tells a page which apply buttons to turn into retire buttons.

Role.description: What a player may do. Admins reach the backoffice and manage players.

SeedOrder.description:
Body of `PUT /api/admin/tournaments/{id}/seeds`: every entrant exactly once,
seed 1 first.

SkillLevel.description: How good the player says they are, 1 for a beginner and 5 for a strong player.

Standing.description:
Where a player stands: the total, the rank it gives, and the place in the
leaderboard. `next` is absent at the top of the ladder.

floor.description: The cycles the current rank starts at.

place.description: 1 is the top. Equal totals share a place.

players.description: How many players the place is among.

StatusChange.description:
Body of `POST /api/admin/tournaments/{id}/status`. A winner is accepted only
with `concluded` and only when the tournament has no bracket.

TemporaryPassword.description:
The answer to an admin password reset. Shown once, never stored in clear, and
never printed: `Debug` redacts it like [`Password`].

TokenResponse.description: The answer to a signup or a login. The token is a bearer JWT.

Tournament.description:
A tournament as every client sees it. `entrant_count` and `has_bracket` ride
along so a list needs no second call per row.

date.description: The day of the event. A day has no timezone.

registrationClosesAt.description: Registrations close at this instant. Past it, nobody applies or retires.

TournamentDetail.description: One tournament with everything a page needs.

TournamentStatus.description:
The life of a tournament. `Draft` is visible to admins only. `Open` takes
registrations until the deadline. `Live` freezes the entrants for the
bracket. `Concluded` is final.

TournamentUpdate.description: Body of `PATCH /api/admin/tournaments/{id}`. An absent field keeps its value.
